study.title: Deep Learning for Semantic Segmentation in Crops: Generalization from Opuntia spp.
study.short_title: Opuntia/Agave cover: Mask2Former IoU 0.897, Dice 0.956, RTX 4060 Ti

segmentation.domain: Binary vegetation/plant cover segmentation of UAV RGB orthomosaics of semi-arid succulent crops (Opuntia spp. prickly pear and Agave salmiana) for cover quantification by pixel counting under GSD control; cross-crop transfer (base training on Opuntia, zero-shot on Agave, fine-tuning on 6.84% of agave tiles, then multi-species consolidation)
segmentation.best_model: Mask2Former (Swin backbone + masked cross-attention decoder): best on Opuntia test set IoU 0.897 +- 0.094, RMSE 0.146, pixel accuracy 0.968 (vs Swin-Transformer second 0.885); after consolidation highest overlap on BOTH crops (IoU 0.894 +- 0.004 Opuntia / 0.760 +- 0.046 Agave) with highest contour fidelity (BF 0.962 +- 0.102 / 0.877 +- 0.153; HD95 2.189 +- 3.447 / 8.458 +- 16.667 px). SegFormer fastest (0.7 ms/tile, IoU 0.799 on Opuntia)

dataset.name: Two author-collected UAV RGB orthomosaic datasets (public on GitHub): Opuntia spp. plot of ~539 m2, Tulancingo Valley, Hidalgo, Mexico (DJI Mavic 2 Mini, 4 m height, 75/70% overlap, 443 x 12 MP photos, WebODM, GSD 1.02 cm/px); Agave salmiana (varieties 'manso'/'chalqueño'), Rancho La Gaspareña, Singuilucan, Hidalgo (61 m flight to standardize pixels-per-organ ~72, 85/80% overlap, 75 photos, GSD 1.8 cm/px). Tiled 96x96 px (non-overlap) then rescaled to 224x224 for ImageNet-pretrained backbones; black-padding tiles excluded from metrics.
dataset.note: Opuntia: 186 original tiles augmented (flips, rotations +/-90/180) to 549, split train/test/val 411/83/55. Agave: 4900 generated tiles filtered to 335 informative (6.84% of tiled set = limited target supervision), split 234/68/33, NOT augmented. Opuntia GSD 1.02 cm/px @ 4 m flight; Agave GSD 1.8 cm/px @ 61 m flight (scale-normalized to ~72 px per leaf/cladode organ). Binary labels vegetation/background via LabelMe. Datasets public: github.com/ArturoDuarteR/Semantic-Segmentation-in-Orthomosaics.

segmentation.backbone: Seven architectures under a unified protocol (NUM_CLASSES=1 binary, 224x224): CNN family - U-Net, U-Net Style Xception (depthwise-separable encoder), SegNet (VGG-16-style max-pooling-index decoder), DeepLabV3+ (Xception + ASPP); Transformer family - Swin-Transformer (shifted-window, UNet-style decoder), SegFormer (MiT encoder + lightweight MLP decoder), Mask2Former (Swin backbone + masked cross-attention query decoder). Optimizers AdamW (Swin uses Adam), BCE-based losses (some +0.5 Dice), stage schedule base/fine-tune/consolidation 150/30/10 epochs, AdamW LR 1e-4/1e-5

mIoU.quote: Mask2Former achieved the highest mean IoU (0.897), the lowest RMSE (0.146), and the highest pixel accuracy (0.968)
mIoU.ambiguity: Binary segmentation: the reported IoU is the single vegetation-class/mean IoU (2 classes). Opuntia test set, mean +- std across tiles (0.897 +- 0.094). After consolidation Mask2Former sustained the highest overlap on both crops: IoU 0.894 +- 0.004 (Opuntia) / 0.760 +- 0.046 (Agave). Cross-crop context: DeepLabV3+ collapsed to 0.000 IoU under zero-shot on Agave (majority-class), recovered to 0.772 +- 0.049 after fine-tuning.

mPA.ambiguity: Mean pixel accuracy not reported; global pixel accuracy reported instead.

F1.ambiguity: F1 not reported; the reported BF score is BOUNDARY F1 (0.962 +- 0.102 Opuntia / 0.877 +- 0.153 Agave after consolidation) - kept distinct, not a standard F1.

Dice.quote: Mask2Former ... highest Dice and BF score and the lowest HD95, indicating superior boundary fidelity in the consolidated setting
Dice.ambiguity: Reported ONLY on the consolidated (multi-species) checkpoints: Dice 0.956 +- 0.036 on Opuntia and 0.922 +- 0.079 on Agave for Mask2Former (highest on Opuntia; Agave comparable to Swin 0.924). Not reported for the base Opuntia-only models.

PA.ambiguity: Global pixel accuracy (Eq. 3, TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FP+FN) on the Opuntia test set; source-class imbalance caveat acknowledged by the authors. After consolidation Mask2Former pixel accuracy 0.967 (Opuntia) / 0.951 (Agave).

weed_F1.ambiguity: Binary vegetation/background task - no crop/weed classes.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Binary vegetation/background task - no crop/weed classes.

edge.device: Desktop workstation: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB, Intel i9-12900K, 32 GB RAM (Pop! OS 22.04, Linux 6.12.10, CUDA 12.8, driver 570.153.02); no embedded/edge deployment

fps.quote: Inference times for Mask2Former and Swin-Transformer are comparable (~8-9 ms per tile)
fps.ambiguity: DERIVED as 1000/8.9 ms per 224x224 tile on desktop RTX 4060 Ti. edge.reported=false. Per-tile times span 0.7 ms (SegFormer, fastest) to 38.9 ms (DeepLabV3+) on Opuntia test; Mask2Former per-tile time inconsistent between Table 3 (0.0089 s) and consolidated Tables 6-7 (0.0237 s).

latency_ms.quote: Inference times for Mask2Former and Swin-Transformer are comparable (~8-9 ms per tile)
latency_ms.ambiguity: Per 224x224 tile on desktop RTX 4060 Ti (reported timg = 0.0089 s for Mask2Former on Opuntia test; Swin-Transformer 0.0083 s). Range across models 0.7 ms (SegFormer) to 38.9 ms (DeepLabV3+). Inconsistency: Mask2Former 23.7 ms/tile in consolidated tables. edge.reported=false.

params_M.ambiguity: Parameter counts not reported in the extracted text (computational cost reported as per-tile inference time only).

issues: edge.reported=false: all inference on a desktop RTX 4060 Ti workstation per 224x224 tile (0.7-38.9 ms depending on architecture); no embedded/edge deployment, no on-device measurements. Mask2Former latency inconsistent between the Opuntia test table (0.0089 s) and consolidated tables (0.0237 s).
Binary vegetation/background segmentation (plant-cover estimation), not crop/weed: single-class IoU reported as the overlap metric; pixel accuracy 0.968 (Mask2Former, Opuntia test).

Transfer study is the core contribution: DeepLabV3+ collapses to IoU 0.000 +- 0.000 under zero-shot on Agave (background-dominant collapse); fine-tuning on 6.84% of agave tiles recovers it to 0.772 (best after FT). After consolidation Mask2Former is best on both crops (0.894/0.760) and retains best contour fidelity (BF 0.962/0.877; HD95 2.189/8.458 px).
Transformer-based models (Mask2Former, Swin) generally lead on Opuntia in accuracy and boundary quality; CNN baselines (U-Net 0.678, U-Net Style Xception 0.667, SegNet 0.597) lag.
Downstream cover quantification (GSD-controlled pixel counting): Mask2Former vs manual masks gives relative area errors of 2.13% (Opuntia, GSD 1.02 cm/px) and 0.25% (Agave, GSD 1.8 cm/px).
Opuntia GSD 1.02 cm/px at 4 m flight height (443 images, 75/70% overlap); Agave GSD 1.8 cm/px at 61 m (scale-standardized to ~72 px/organ, 85/80% overlap). Datasets + code public (GitHub).
